newsitem.title: GERMANY: Metro sees higher oper profit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Metro sees higher oper profit in 1997.

text.p: German retailing group Metro said on Wednesday it expects operating profit this year to exceed last year's 1.062 billion marks ($603.4 million).
But chairman Klaus Wiegandt told the company's annual general meeting that start-up losses from international operations would total about 100 million marks. ($ = 1.759 German Marks)

Europe's largest retail chain expects sales this year to reach 65 billion marks, up three billion marks, before adding in the recently acquired Peacock AG, which will add about 950 million marks in sales.
The main areas of internationalisation are Poland, Turkey and China.
